pentestPackages.name: Starter
pentestPackages.description: For landing pages, corporate sites, and small web apps
pentestPackages.scope: 15 AI-powered security checks across your external attack surface
pentestPackages.scopeTooltip: Each check targets a distinct vulnerability category. Our AI runs every check automatically and a human analyst validates the findings before delivery.

checks.name: SSL/TLS Certificate Audit
checks.detail: Validates certificate chain, expiry date, protocol versions (TLS 1.2/1.3), and cipher suite strength.

checks.name: HTTP Security Headers Scan
checks.detail: Checks for HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy.

checks.name: Content Security Policy (CSP) Analysis
checks.detail: AI detects missing or bypassable CSP directives that allow script injection from untrusted sources.

checks.name: SQL Injection Detection
checks.detail: AI fuzzes all URL parameters and form inputs for SQL injection patterns — including blind and time-based variants.

checks.name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Detection
checks.detail: Scans all input surfaces for reflected and DOM-based XSS vulnerabilities using AI-generated payloads.

checks.name: Exposed Sensitive Files Check
checks.detail: Scans for publicly accessible .env, .git, /admin, backup files, and configuration files left exposed by mistake.

checks.name: Directory & Path Enumeration
checks.detail: Detects open directory listings and hidden routes that reveal internal application structure.

checks.name: Subdomain Takeover Risk
checks.detail: Enumerates all subdomains and flags dangling DNS records that an attacker could register and hijack.

checks.name: DNS Security Review
checks.detail: Validates SPF, DMARC, and DKIM email authentication records and checks zone transfer protections.

checks.name: Open Ports & Services Fingerprinting
checks.detail: Maps all external-facing services and detects unnecessary or misconfigured ports that expand your attack surface.

checks.name: Cookie Security Flags Audit
checks.detail: Verifies that all cookies carry HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite attributes to prevent session hijacking.

checks.name: CORS Policy Review
checks.detail: Detects overly permissive cross-origin resource sharing configurations that allow unauthorized data access.

checks.name: Information Disclosure Detection
checks.detail: AI hunts for server banners, stack traces, version leaks, and error messages that give attackers a roadmap.

checks.name: Third-Party Script Risk Assessment
checks.detail: Catalogs every external script loaded by your site and flags high-risk or unrecognized sources.

checks.name: Clickjacking Vulnerability Check
checks.detail: Tests iframe embedding protection via X-Frame-Options and CSP frame-ancestors directives.

pentestPackages.notIncluded: No re-test included — see Business plan

pentestPackages.name: Business
pentestPackages.description: For web apps with login, payments, or user data
pentestPackages.scope: 40 AI-powered security checks — 15 from Starter + 25 application-layer checks
pentestPackages.scopeTooltip: Our AI runs authenticated sessions inside your app, probing login flows, business logic, APIs, and session management — areas invisible to external scanners.
deliverables: 1 Free Re-test After You Fix Issues

checks.name: Login Brute Force Protection Audit
checks.detail: AI tests rate limiting, account lockout thresholds, and CAPTCHA bypass to verify your login can't be hammered.

checks.name: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) Bypass
checks.detail: Tests OTP replay attacks, MFA fatigue techniques, and fallback mechanism weaknesses.

checks.name: Password Reset Flow Security
checks.detail: Checks reset token predictability, expiry windows, and whether tokens can be reused or leaked via Referer headers.

checks.name: Session Fixation Attack Testing
checks.detail: Verifies that session tokens are regenerated on login and never accepted from pre-authentication state.

checks.name: Session Token Entropy & Expiry Audit
checks.detail: AI analyzes token randomness, length, and whether idle sessions expire correctly on server side.

checks.name: Horizontal Privilege Escalation (IDOR)
checks.detail: AI systematically manipulates object references to test if User A can access or modify User B's data.

checks.name: Vertical Privilege Escalation
checks.detail: Tests whether a standard user can elevate to admin or moderator roles by manipulating requests or tokens.

checks.name: Price & Quantity Manipulation
checks.detail: For e-commerce: AI intercepts and modifies checkout requests to test if prices, quantities, or discounts can be tampered client-side.

checks.name: Race Condition Detection
checks.detail: Sends concurrent requests to exploit time-of-check to time-of-use (TOCTOU) flaws — common in payments and coupon systems.

checks.name: Multi-Step Workflow Bypass
checks.detail: Tests whether steps in checkout, onboarding, or approval flows can be skipped by jumping directly to later endpoints.

checks.name: Malicious File Upload Testing
checks.detail: AI attempts to upload executable files (.php, .exe, .svg with XSS) and tests MIME type validation bypass.

checks.name: Path Traversal via File Upload
checks.detail: Tests whether uploaded filenames can escape the intended directory using ../ sequences.

checks.name: XML External Entity (XXE) Injection
checks.detail: Checks all XML-processing endpoints for XXE vulnerabilities that can expose server files or trigger SSRF.

checks.name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
checks.detail: AI probes URL input fields and webhooks to test if the server can be tricked into fetching internal resources.

checks.name: Command Injection Testing
checks.detail: Tests inputs that interact with OS commands (file conversions, ping tools, etc.) for shell injection vulnerabilities.

checks.name: API Authentication & Authorization Audit
checks.detail: Verifies that every API endpoint enforces proper auth — including endpoints not linked in the UI.

checks.name: API Rate Limiting & Throttling Check
checks.detail: Tests whether APIs can be abused via mass enumeration, scraping, or credential stuffing without triggering limits.

checks.name: JWT Token Security Audit
checks.detail: Checks for algorithm confusion attacks (RS256→HS256), weak secrets, missing expiry, and unsigned token acceptance.

checks.name: OAuth Flow Security Review
checks.detail: Tests redirect URI manipulation, state parameter absence (CSRF on OAuth), and token leakage in authorization flows.

checks.name: GraphQL Security Testing
checks.detail: If GraphQL is present: tests introspection exposure, batching attacks, and deeply nested query DoS.

checks.name: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
checks.detail: Verifies CSRF token implementation on all state-changing requests — especially account settings and payments.

checks.name: Token Leakage in URLs & Logs
checks.detail: Checks if session tokens, API keys, or JWTs are exposed in URLs, browser history, server logs, or Referer headers.

checks.name: Concurrent Session Management
checks.detail: Tests whether multiple simultaneous sessions are allowed and if existing sessions are invalidated on password change.

checks.name: Logout & Session Invalidation
checks.detail: Verifies that server-side session is fully invalidated on logout — not just cleared client-side.

checks.name: Sensitive Data Exposure in API Responses
checks.detail: AI inspects API responses for over-exposed fields: passwords, internal IDs, PII, or data that shouldn't reach the client.

faq.q: How long does the audit take?
faq.a: Starter audits are delivered in 3–5 business days. Business audits take 7–10 business days. Enterprise timelines are agreed at the kickoff call based on scope. All deadlines are confirmed before we start.

faq.q: What do you need from us to get started?
faq.a: A scoping call (30 min), the URL(s) to test, written authorization, and for Business/Enterprise, a test account with elevated permissions. We handle everything else.

Each check targets a specific vulnerability category — for example, SQL injection on all input fields, or SSL misconfiguration across your domain. Starter covers your external perimeter. Business adds authenticated and logic-layer checks.

faq.q: Can we get a custom quote for a large application?
faq.a: Absolutely. Enterprise pricing is scoped to your asset inventory — number of pages, API endpoints, user roles, and integrations. Contact us and we'll respond with a proposal within 24 hours.

faq.q: Is the free scan on your homepage the same as a paid audit?
faq.a: No. The free scanner is an automated surface-level check — useful for a quick health snapshot. A paid audit is a manual and AI-assisted deep investigation by a human security analyst, with a signed report you can share with clients or regulators.
